The Sports Club Physical Therapy is an expert physical therapy & sports performance clinic located in The Sports Club of West Bloomfield, MI.

Our on-site physical therapists, personal trainers, and massage therapists provide unique, individualized treatment unlike anywhere else! Our team is dedicated to helping you not only recover from immediate injury, but also by promoting an active, healthy lifestyle.
